title: Hadithi (Theme 3: Dhiki zinazokumba wanyama)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child places the hadithi in its kind and occasion, explains its maana with an example, and presents it with the audience taking part.

floor.prerequisite: Tells a riddle or a story with the formula.
floor.question: Kitendawili! - ?

representations: a recording or a performance of "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni"
steps: Listen to or read the text.
Explain its maana with an example.
contexts: an evening of stories at home

board.do: Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni

board.say: Hii ni hadithi ya aina gani, na inatumika lini?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child presents a short piece with the class responding.

misconceptions.ask: Hutumika lini, na kwa lengo gani?
misconceptions.repair: "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni mighani: ushujaa na ulinzi wa jamii huheshimiwa.

misconceptions.ask: Ilipokezwa kwa maandishi au kwa mdomo?
misconceptions.repair: Hadithi ni fasihi simulizi: hupokezwa kwa mdomo.
Mighani hutumika kusimulia historia ya shujaa wa jamii na kumsifu.

listen_for: Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe ni funzo kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.

checks.question: "Fumo Liyongo, shujaa wa Pate aliyeshindwa tu kwa sindano ya shaba kitovuni" ni hadithi ya aina gani?
Mighani hutumika lini?
checks.answer: kusimulia historia ya shujaa wa jamii na kumsifu
